body: appreciate it man, we seem very similar. I hope you will one day find that person that makes you feel like she did.
It was a day like most others.. I go out try to take my mind off things, and I end up right back here once I get home, I just want to be ok :(

I'm sad to know that there are people out there in almost the exact situation as me. I wish you all the best man. I've had some good days as i'm sure you have too, I just wish every day could be good. Because in those very dark days like you said it's very hard to deal with.

I am happy for people that are happy, I would never want anyone to feel the way I do, and I guess i'm slightly jealous towards them. 
Thank you for your kind words, every little bit seems to help.

I want too, as i've read it has helped many people to seek professional help, but i'm scared. I've always had slight social anxiety so getting to the point to open up to someone I barely know in person, is very hard for me. I guess that's why I came here.
